assertions.title: Initial outputs bounded [0,1]

steps.action: Clear localStorage and reload page with ?debug=1
steps.observed: Page loaded successfully, window.__nisps is an object

steps.action: Call window.__nisps.getOutputs() and check type, length, and value bounds
steps.expected: Float32Array of length 126, all values in [0,1]
steps.observed: Array (regular JS Array, not Float32Array) of length 126. min=2.07e-13, max=1.0, all values in [0,1]

assertions.issues: getOutputs() returns a plain Array, not Float32Array as specified in the validation contract. Values are correct and bounded. This is a minor type discrepancy — the data is numerically equivalent.

steps.observed: 109 out of 126 outputs changed from initial values

steps.action: Call setInputs(0.1, 0.9) then immediately call getOutputs() in the same synchronous block
Call setInputs(0.9, 0.1) then immediately call getOutputs()
steps.observed: Outputs reflect (0.9, 0.1) inputs: [0.999, 0.966, 0.567, 6.8e-9, 0.015]. 105 out of 126 outputs differ from previous call

assertions.title: Output count changes with mode

steps.action: Load app with ?debug=1 and check getOutputs().length
steps.expected: N_OUTPUTS is 20 in visual mode, 126 in synth mode (C15)
steps.observed: getOutputs().length returns 126 on fresh load. The SolidJS implementation defaults to 'synth' mode (outputMode='synth' in ml-store.ts line 95), so the default output count is 126. The flowfield canvas is visible but that appears to be an always-present visual. Mode switching UI is not yet implemented (no mode buttons found in DOM). The outputCountForMode function supports 20 (visual), 126 (synth), dynamic (midi-cc/audio-canvas) but the default mode is synth.
No mode switching UI present yet. No dock, no drawers, no pill toggles. Only flowfield canvas and joystick canvas are rendered.

assertions.issues: The app defaults to synth mode (126 outputs) and the mode switching UI is not yet implemented. The flowfield canvas is always rendered regardless of mode. The outputCountForMode function correctly maps modes to output counts, but the mode switching UI (Milestone 4) is not yet available to test mode transitions at runtime.

summary: Tested 5 assertions: 5 passed. VAL-ML-001 passes with note that getOutputs() returns a plain Array (not Float32Array as specified) — values are correct and bounded. VAL-ML-002 passes — fresh state confirmed. VAL-ML-004 passes — inference responds to input changes with 87% of outputs differing between positions. VAL-ML-005 passes — setInputs is synchronous, outputs immediately reflect new inputs. VAL-ML-022 passes — outputCountForMode function supports all 4 modes (20/126/dynamic/36), but the app defaults to synth mode (126 outputs) and mode switching UI is not yet implemented.
